description.value: JJ Bean is a well-regarded Vancouver-based independent specialty coffee roaster and cafe chain, operating since 1996 with a strong reputation for high-quality seasonal single-origin coffees and espresso blends. This Burnaby outpost, known as the Heights location, sits on Hastings Street and offers fresh daily baking alongside espresso drinks and takeaway options. It is a popular neighbourhood cafe that would serve as a comfortable rest stop for cyclists riding through Burnaby.
